subject: Rick Caraviello Mayoral Candidacy Interview
overview: The Medford Bytes podcast interviewed City Councilor Rick Caraviello regarding his 2023 mayoral campaign. Caraviello discussed development delays, City Hall staffing challenges, and his vision for unifying the city.

items.title: Candidate introduction
items.summary: Rick Caraviello introduced himself as a six-term Medford City Councilor currently running for mayor.

items.title: Motivation for mayoral run
items.summary: Caraviello expressed dissatisfaction with the city's direction, arguing that Medford failed to capitalize on a regional building boom compared to neighboring cities.

items.title: Housing and 40B projects
items.summary: The candidate criticized the administration for litigating 40B housing projects, claiming the city lost millions in tax revenue and legal fees by not negotiating.

items.title: City Hall operations and staffing
items.summary: Caraviello proposed a culture shift in City Hall to prioritize resident assistance and suggested restructuring salaries to attract talent to vacant department head positions.

items.title: Podcast fact check on wage adjustment vote
items.summary: Host Danielle Balocca inserted a correction noting that despite his verbal support for living wages, Caraviello voted against cost-of-living raises for non-union personnel in April 2023.

items.title: Equity and board representation
items.summary: The candidate advocated for diverse board appointments and criticized the current Charter Review Commission for lacking Asian and ward-based representation.

items.title: Barriers to volunteerism
items.summary: Discussion centered on how the lack of stipends and childcare prevents marginalized residents from participating in city boards and commissions.

items.title: Charter review and ward representation
items.summary: Caraviello stated he is not a proponent of ward-based representation and believes the City Council should be a more active partner in government.

items.title: Vision for city unity
items.summary: Caraviello proposed unifying 'old' and 'new' Medford residents through increased community events and a welcoming governance style.

items.title: Legislative achievements
items.summary: Caraviello highlighted his roles in funding the new public library, establishing a new arts center, and saving the local ice rink.
